# Prepare allele frequencies

## randomly switch tracked allele


<!-- rnb-text-end -->


<!-- rnb-chunk-begin -->


<!-- rnb-source-begin  -->

```r
```r
set.seed(1111)

# LD-pruned data
#gen0 <- read.table(\../data/average_seedmix_p0_LDpruned.txt\, sep = \\t\)
#hapfire <- read.table(\../data/merged_hapFIRE_allele_frequency_LDpruned.txt\, sep = \\t\, header = T)

# full dataset
gen0 <- vroom(\/global/scratch/users/milesroberts/tmp/average_seedmix_p0.txt\, delim = \\t\, col_names = F)

# randomly swith which allele is being tracked
# right now, the non-reference allele is always the one we're tracking
idx <- sample(c(T,F), size = nrow(gen0), replace = T)
gen0[idx,\X3\] <- 1 - gen0[idx,\X3\]

write.csv(gen0, \/global/scratch/users/milesroberts/moi_lab_projects/grenenet-phase2/data/seedmix_hapfire_allele_frequency_random_switch.csv\, quote = F, row.names = F)

## remove fixed and lost loci

<!-- rnb-chunk-begin -->

```r
# initial generation
# tracked allele randomly switched
gen0 <- fread(\/global/scratch/users/milesroberts/moi_lab_projects/grenenet-phase2/data/seedmix_hapfire_allele_frequency_random_switch.csv\, data.table = F)

# later gen

# omit allele frequencies that start near abosrbing boundaries
non_abosrbing_freq <- (gen0$X3 >= 1/231) & (gen0$X3 <= 1 - 1/231)
gen0 <- gen0[non_abosrbing_freq,]
hapfire <- hapfire[non_abosrbing_freq,]

rm(non_abosrbing_freq)
gc()

# output filtered seedmix frequencies
write.table(gen0, \/global/scratch/users/milesroberts/moi_lab_projects/grenenet-phase2/data/seedmix_hapfire_allele_frequency_random_switch_fixrm.csv\, row.names = F, sep = \

# apply function per chunk and append to file
chunked_arcsin_sqrt <- function(output) {
  function(x, pos) {
    cat(paste(pos, Sys.time(), \\n\))
    append_table(arcsin_sqrt(x), output)
  }
}

# loop over chunks of csv
read_csv_chunked(

<!-- rnb-text-begin -->


## Try modifying Feder test to account for sampling noise


<!-- rnb-text-end -->


<!-- rnb-chunk-begin -->


<!-- rnb-source-begin  -->

```r
```r

p0 = 0.5
N0 = 500
L = 1:30
lambda = 100

truth = c(p0)
estims = c(p0)
covs = c(lambda)

# simulate 
for(i in L){
  # generate new generation
  x1 <- rbinom(1, N0, prob = p0)
  p1 <- x1/N0
  # sequencing
  coverage <- rpois(1, lambda = lambda)
  x1_hat <- rbinom(1, size = coverage, prob = p1)
  p1_hat <- x1_hat/coverage
  # save results
  truth = c(truth, p1)
  estims = c(estims, p1_hat)
  covs = c(covs, coverage)
}

results = data.frame(
  p = truth,
  p_hat = estims,
  cov = covs,
  i = c(0, L)
)

variance_table = data.frame(
  dt = diff(results$i),
  cov1 = results$cov[1:(nrow(results) - 1)],
  cov2 = results$cov[2:nrow(results)],
  dp = 2*results$p_hat[-1]*(1 - results$p_hat[-1])
)


variance_table$var = sqrt(variance_table$dt * variance_table$dp * (1/variance_table$cov1 + 1/variance_table$cov2))

z_stats <- diff(results$p_hat)/variance_table$var

hist(z_stats)

shapiro.test(z_stats)
```
```

<!-- rnb-source-end -->

# GLM 

https://doi.org/10.1038/s41586-024-07834-x

## calculate GLM


<!-- rnb-text-end -->


<!-- rnb-chunk-begin -->


<!-- rnb-source-begin  -->

```r
```r
# make list of sites
sites <- unique(gsub(\_.*\, \\, colnames(hapfire)))

# for now, ignore sites that lack reps with contiguous generations
#sites <- sites[c(1,3,5:17,19:21,23,25:29,31)]
sites <- sites[c(-30,-32)]

# number of snps per window
window_size <- 3000

# create windows, should not bleed between chromosomes
blocks <- gen0 %>%
  group_by(X1) %>%
  mutate(block = (row_number() - 1) %/% window_size + 1,
         block = paste(X1, block, sep = \_\))

length(unique(blocks$block))

hapfire$block <- blocks$block

#output_glm <- paste(\/global/scratch/users/milesroberts/moi_lab_projects/grenenet-phase2/results/\, today, \/glm_quasibinomial_coef.txt\, sep = \\)
output_glm <- paste(\/global/scratch/users/milesroberts/moi_lab_projects/grenenet-phase2/results/2026-05-04/glm_quasibinomial_coef.txt\, sep = \\)

unique_blocks <- unique(hapfire$block)

# need to wrap function to handle cases when the data for a snp is all NA
safe_glm <- possibly(.f = function(df) {
  glm(value ~ t, data = df, weights = n, family = quasibinomial(link = \logit\))
}, otherwise = NULL)

for(b in unique_blocks[320:418]){
  print(paste(\Window:\, b))
  hap_block <- hapfire %>% filter(block == b)
  for(site in unique(sites)){
    print(paste(\Site:\, site))
    hap_site <- hap_block %>% dplyr::select(starts_with(paste(site, \_\, sep = \\)))
    gen0_block <- blocks %>% filter(block == b) %>% dplyr::select(starts_with(\X\))
    
    # get sample sizes
    rep_n <- sample_sizes[(sample_sizes$site_gen_plot %in% colnames(hap_site)),]
    rep_n <- rbind(c(0, 1e3), rep_n)
    rep_n <- rep_n %>% arrange(site_gen_plot)
    
    # sort names to be in order of generation
    hap_site <- hap_site %>% relocate(all_of(sort(colnames(hap_site))))
    
    hap_site <- cbind(hap_site, gen0_block)
    
    hap_site <- reshape2::melt(hap_site, id = c(\X1\, \X2\))
    
    names(hap_site)[3] <- \site_gen_plot\
    
    hap_site <- merge(hap_site, rep_n, by = \site_gen_plot\, all.x = T)
    
    hap_site$t <- gsub(\_\, \\, str_extract(hap_site$site_gen_plot, \_.*_\))
    
    hap_site$t[hap_site$site_gen_plot == \X3\] <- 0
    
    hap_site$t <- as.numeric(hap_site$t)
    
    print(\Building GLMs...\)
    mod_res <- hap_site %>% group_by(X1, X2) %>%  
      filter( (value <= 1) & (value >= 0) ) %>%
      nest() %>%
      mutate(
        # calculate intercept in same scale as logit
        #fixed_intercept = map_dbl(data, ~ as.numeric(.x[(.x$site_gen_plot == \X3\), \value\])),
        #fixed_intercept_logit = log(fixed_intercept/(1-fixed_intercept)),
        # Fit the model to each nested data frame (.x)
        #model = map(data, ~glm(value ~ t - 1 + offset(rep(fixed_intercept_logit, length(value))), data = .x, weights = n, family = quasibinomial(link = \logit\))),
        # fit glm, but don't force fixed intercept
        #model = map(data, ~glm(value ~ t, data = .x, weights = n, family = quasibinomial(link = \logit\))),
        model = map(data, ~safe_glm(.x)),
        # Extract coefficients in a tidy format
        tidied = map(model, tidy)
      ) %>%
      # Flatten the results back into a regular data frame
      unnest(tidied) %>% 
      filter(term == \t\) %>%
      dplyr::select(c(\X1\, \X2\, \estimate\, \std.error\, \statistic\, \p.value\))
    
    print(\Saving output...\)
    mod_res$site = site # add site label
    mod_res$block = b # add site label
    write.table(mod_res, output_glm, col.names=!file.exists(output_glm), append = T, row.names = F, sep = \\t\, quote = F)
    print(Sys.time())
  }
  gc()
}

for(site in unique(sites)){
  print(paste(\Site:\, site))
  hap_site <- hapfire %>% 
    dplyr::select(starts_with(paste(site, \_\, sep = \\))) %>%

  for(exprep in 1:12){
    print(paste(\Rep:\, exprep))

    hap_rep <- hap_rep %>% relocate(all_of(sort(colnames(hap_rep))))

    gt_result$site<-site
    gt_result$rep<-exprep

sign_permute_blocks <- create_blocks(gen0, X1, X2, 15000, \_\)
#hapfire$window <- sign_permute_blocks$window

W <- length(unique(sign_permute_blocks$window))
B <- 200

# define output
output_gt_boot <-  paste(
  \/global/scratch/users/milesroberts/moi_lab_projects/grenenet-phase2/results/\,
  today,
  \/gt_bootstraps.tsv\,
  sep = \\
)

#check_file_exists(output_gt_boot)

# loop over sites
# make list of sites, ignoring some
sites <- unique(gsub(\_.*\, \\, colnames(hapfire)))
sites <- sites[c(-30)]

for(site in unique(sites)[26:30]){
  print(paste(\Site:\, site))
  hap_site <- hapfire %>% 
    dplyr::select(starts_with(paste(site, \_\, sep = \\))) %>%
    collect()
  
  for(exprep in 1:12){
    print(paste(\Rep:\, exprep))
    hap_rep <- hap_site %>% 
      dplyr::select(ends_with(paste(\_\, exprep, sep = \\)))
    
    # sort names to be in order of generation
    hap_rep <- hap_rep %>% relocate(all_of(sort(colnames(hap_rep))))
    
    if(ncol(hap_rep) <= 2){
      print(\Need at least two increments. Skipping to next replicate...\)
      next
    }
    
    rep_n <- grab_sample_sizes(sample_sizes, site_gen_plot, colnames(hap_rep), 10000)
    
    hap_rep <- cbind(gen0$X3, hap_rep)
    colnames(hap_rep)[1] = paste(site, \_0_\, exprep, sep = \\)
    
    hap_rep$window <- sign_permute_blocks$window
    # bootstrap sample allele frequencies by window
    nested <- hap_rep %>% nest_by(window) %>% ungroup()
    
    for (b in 1:B){
      gt_boot <- nested %>%
        slice_sample(n = W, replace = TRUE) %>%
        unnest(cols = c(data)) %>%
        dplyr::select(-window) %>%
        as.data.frame() %>%
        covmat_from_pmat(data, 
                         n = rep_n$n, 
                         correct_for_n = T, 
                         input_asin_trans = F, 
                         procedure = \none\) %>%
        gt_from_covmat()
      
      gt_boot$site <- site
      gt_boot$rep <- exprep
      gt_boot$boot <- b
      append_table(gt_boot, output_gt_boot)
    }
  }
}

gt_boot_results <- fread(output_gt_boot) %>% 
  distinct(site, rep, gen, boot, .keep_all = T)

gt_boot_rep_cis <- gt_boot_results %>%
  group_by(site, rep, gen) %>%

    lwr = quantile(sum_cov, 0.025, na.rm = T),
    med = median(sum_cov, na.rm = T),
    upr = quantile(sum_cov, 0.975, na.rm = T)
  )

gt_boot_mean_cis <- gt_boot_results %>%
  group_by(site, gen, boot) %>% # average across replicates within bootstrap
  summarize(sum_cov = mean(sum_cov)) %>%
  summarize(
    lwr = quantile(sum_cov, 0.025, na.rm = T),
    med = median(sum_cov, na.rm = T),
    upr = quantile(sum_cov, 0.975, na.rm = T)

ggplot(gt_results, aes(x = gen, y = sum_cov, group = interaction(site, rep))) +

# make list of sites
# for now, ignore some sites
sites <- unique(gsub(\_.*\, \\, colnames(hapfire)))
sites <- sites[c(-30)]

# permuation parameters
sign_permute_replicates <- 300
sign_permute_blocks <- create_blocks(gen0, X1, X2, 15000, \_\)

# define output
output_gt_perm <- paste(
  \/global/scratch/users/milesroberts/moi_lab_projects/grenenet-phase2/results/\,
  today,
  \/gt_permutations.tsv\,
  sep = \\
)

#check_file_exists(output_gt_perm)

# loop over sites
for (site in unique(sites)[29:30]) {
  print(paste(\Site:\, site))
  hap_site <- hapfire %>% 
    dplyr::select(starts_with(paste(site, \_\, sep = \\))) %>%
    collect()
  
  for (exprep in 1:12) {
    print(paste(\Rep:\, exprep))
    hap_rep <- hap_site %>%
      dplyr::select(ends_with(paste(\_\, exprep, sep = \\)))
    
    # sort names to be in order of generation
    hap_rep <- hap_rep %>%
      relocate(all_of(sort(colnames(hap_rep))))
    
    if (ncol(hap_rep) <= 2) {
      print(\Need at least two increments. Skipping to next replicate...\)
      next
    }
    
    rep_n <- grab_sample_sizes(sample_sizes, site_gen_plot, colnames(hap_rep), 10000)
    
    hap_rep <- cbind(gen0$X3, hap_rep)
    colnames(hap_rep)[1] = paste(site, \_0_\, exprep, sep = \\)
    
    for (p in 1:sign_permute_replicates) {
      covmat <- covmat_from_pmat(
        hap_rep,
        rep_n$n,
        correct_for_n = T,
        input_asin_trans = F,
        procedure = \window\,
        windows = sign_permute_blocks$window
      )
      
      gt_perm_result <- gt_from_covmat(covmat)
      
      gt_perm_result$site = site
      gt_perm_result$rep = exprep
      gt_perm_result$perm = p
      
      append_table(gt_perm_result, output_gt_perm)
      #gt_perm_results <- rbind(gt_perm_results, gt_perm_result)
    }
  }
}

### calculate frequency increments


<!-- rnb-text-end -->


<!-- rnb-chunk-begin -->


<!-- rnb-source-begin  -->

```r
```r
# make list of sites
sites <- unique(gsub(\_.*\, \\, colnames(hapfire)))

# for now, ignore sites that do not have at least 2 incremenent
#sites <- sites[c(-11, -14, -18, -19, -30, -31)]
sites <- sites[-30]

# loop over sites
pdiffs <- NULL
gc()

for(site in sites) {
  print(paste(\Site:\, site))
  for (i in 1:12) {
    print(paste(\Rep:\, i))
    hap_rep_i <- hapfire %>% dplyr::select(starts_with(paste(site, \_\, sep = \\)) & ends_with(paste(\_\, i, sep = \\)))
    # if (ncol(hap_rep_i) <= 1) {
    #   print(\Need at least two increments. Skipping to next replicate...\)
    #   n_valid_reps <- n_valid_reps - 1
    #   next
    # }
    
    # get sample sizes
    # n_i <- sample_sizes[(sample_sizes$site_gen_plot %in% colnames(hap_rep_i)), ]
    # n_i <- rbind(c(0, 1e5), n_i)
    # n_i <- n_i %>% arrange(site_gen_plot)
    
    # sort names to be in order of generation
    hap_rep_i <- hap_rep_i %>% relocate(all_of(sort(colnames(hap_rep_i))))
    # create matrix of allele frequencies
    # L X G
    pmat_i <- NULL
    pmat_i <- cbind(pmat_i, gen0$X3)
    colnames(pmat_i)[1] <- \0\
    pmat_i <- cbind(pmat_i, hap_rep_i)
    #colnames(pmat_i)[2:ncol(pmat_i)] <- colnames(hap_rep_i)
    
    # for (w in 1:ncol(hap_rep_i)) {
    #   pmat_i <- cbind(pmat_i, hap_rep_i[, w])
    #   colnames(pmat_i)[w + 1] <- colnames(hap_rep_i)[w]
    # }
    
    # calculate increments
    pdiff_i <- as.matrix(pmat_i[, -1] - pmat_i[, -ncol(pmat_i)])
    colnames(pdiff_i) <- colnames(hap_rep_i)
    pdiffs <- cbind(pdiffs, pdiff_i)
  }
}

# save increment matrix
write.csv(pdiffs, \/global/scratch/users/milesroberts/moi_lab_projects/grenenet-phase2/data/allele_frequency_increments.csv\, row.names = F, quote = F)

### correct covariances for sample size


<!-- rnb-text-end -->


<!-- rnb-chunk-begin -->


<!-- rnb-source-begin  -->

```r
```r
# load covariance matrix as matrix object
if(!exists(\cov_pdiffs\)){
  cov_pdiffs <- as.matrix(read.table(\/global/scratch/users/milesroberts/moi_lab_projects/grenenet-phase2/data/raw_increment_covariances.txt\, header = TRUE, row.names = 1))
  colnames(cov_pdiffs) <- gsub(\X\, \\, colnames(cov_pdiffs))
}

# make list of sites
sites <- unique(gsub(\_.*\, \\, colnames(hapfire)))

# for now, ignore sites that lack reps with contiguous generations
#sites <- sites[c(1,3,5:17,19:21,23,25:29,31)]
sites <- sites[-30]

# rows and replicates
rows_cov_pdiffs <- rownames(cov_pdiffs)
cols_cov_pdiffs <- colnames(cov_pdiffs)

# create new matrix to store bias-corrected cov matrices
unbiased_cov_pdiffs <- cov_pdiffs

# loop over sites
for(site in sites) {
  print(paste(\Site:\, site))
  for(exprep in 1:12) {
    print(paste(\Rep:\, exprep))
    # subset to one site
    hap_rep <- hapfire %>% select(starts_with(paste(site, \_\, sep = \\)) & ends_with(paste(\_\, exprep, sep = \\)))
    
    if(ncol(hap_rep) <= 1){
      print(\Need at least two increments. Skipping to next replicate...\)
      next
    }
    
    # get sample sizes
    rep_n <- sample_sizes[(sample_sizes$site_gen_plot %in% colnames(hap_rep)),]
    rep_n <- rbind(c(0, 1e5), rep_n)
    rep_n <- rep_n %>% arrange(site_gen_plot)
    
    # sort names to be in order of generation
    hap_rep <- hap_rep %>% relocate(all_of(sort(colnames(hap_rep))))
    
    # create matrix of allele frequencies
    # L X G
    pmat <- NULL
    pmat <- cbind(pmat, gen0$X3)
    colnames(pmat)[1] <- \0\
    for(i in 1:ncol(hap_rep)){
      pmat <- cbind(pmat, hap_rep[,i])
      colnames(pmat)[i+1] <- colnames(hap_rep)[i]
    }
    
    # subset covariance matrix
    covmat <- cov_pdiffs[grep(paste(\^\, site, \_.*_\, exprep, \$\, sep = \\), rows_cov_pdiffs), grep(paste(\^\, site, \_.*_\, exprep, \$\, sep = \\), cols_cov_pdiffs)]
    
    # correct covariance matrix for sample size
    correct_covmat <- correct_covmat_for_n(covmat, pmat, rep_n$n)
    
    unbiased_cov_pdiffs[grep(paste(\^\, site, \_.*_\, exprep, \$\, sep = \\), rows_cov_pdiffs), grep(paste(\^\, site, \_.*_\, exprep, \$\, sep = \\), cols_cov_pdiffs)] <- correct_covmat
  }
}

# check that correction behaved as expected
boolean_cov_pdiffs <- (unbiased_cov_pdiffs > cov_pdiffs)

# save corrected covariance matrix
write.table(cov_pdiffs, \/global/scratch/users/milesroberts/moi_lab_projects/grenenet-phase2/data/unbiased_increment_covariances.tsv\, row.names = T, col.names = T, quote = F, sep = \\t\)

### block covariances across all replicates


<!-- rnb-text-end -->


<!-- rnb-chunk-begin -->


<!-- rnb-source-begin  -->

```r
```r
pdiffs <- as.data.frame(pdiffs)
if(!exists(\pdiffs\)){
  pdiffs <- fread(\/global/scratch/users/milesroberts/moi_lab_projects/grenenet-phase2/data/allele_frequency_increments.csv\, header = T)
}

# if(!exists(\cov_pdiffs\)){
#   cov_pdiffs <- fread(\/global/scratch/users/milesroberts/moi_lab_projects/grenenet-phase2/data/unbiased_increment_covariances.tsv\, header = T, row.names = 1))
# 
#   colnames(cov_pdiffs) <- gsub(\X\, \\, colnames(cov_pdiffs))
# }

# number of snps per window
window_size <- 15000

# create windows, should not bleed between chromosomes
blocks <- gen0 %>%
  group_by(X1) %>%
  mutate(block = (row_number() - 1) %/% window_size + 1,
         window = paste(X1, block, sep = \_\))

length(unique(blocks$window))

pdiffs$window <- blocks$window

conv_gt_results <- NULL

for(w in unique(pdiffs$window)){
  print(paste(\Window:\, w))
  pdiff_w <- pdiffs %>% filter(window == w) %>% select(-window)
  
  # increment covariances
  cov_pdiffs <- cov(pdiff_w, use = \pairwise.complete.obs\)
  
  # covariances within a rep
  row_rep <- gsub(\_.*_\, \\, rownames(cov_pdiffs))
  col_rep <- gsub(\_.*_\, \\, colnames(cov_pdiffs))
  
  row_site <- gsub(\_.*\, \\, rownames(cov_pdiffs))
  col_site <- gsub(\_.*\, \\, colnames(cov_pdiffs))
  
  row_gen <- gsub(\_\, \\, str_extract(rownames(cov_pdiffs), \_.*_\))
  col_gen <- gsub(\_\, \\, str_extract(colnames(cov_pdiffs), \_.*_\))
  
  total_var <- 0
  nreps <- 0
  for(k in unique(row_rep)){
    cov_k <- cov_pdiffs[k == row_rep, k == col_rep]
    # TO DO: correct covariances within reps by sample size
    total_var <- total_var + sum(cov_k)
    nreps <- nreps + 1
  }
  
  # covariances across reps
  total_covar <- 0
  for(k in unique(row_site)){
    for(g in unique(row_gen)){
      cov_k <- cov_pdiffs[(k == row_site) & (g == row_gen), (k != col_site) & (g != col_gen)]
      total_covar <- total_covar + sum(cov_k)
    }
  }
  
  # save results
  # npairs is actually number of pairs*2 because I'm double-counting covariances above
  npairs = ((length(unique(row_site))*length(unique(row_gen)))^2 - length(unique(row_site))*length(unique(row_gen)))
    
  conv_gt_result = data.frame(window = w,
                      S = nrow(pdiff_w),
                      nreps = nreps,
                      npairs = npairs,
                      total_covar = total_covar,
                      total_var = total_var,
                      mean_covar = total_covar/npairs,
                      mean_var = total_var/nreps)
  
  conv_gt_results <-  rbind(conv_gt_results, conv_gt_result)
}

# save results
write.table(conv_gt_results, paste(results_path, \block_conv_gt_for_bootstrapping.txt\, sep = \\), row.names = F, quote = F, sep = \\t\)

### covariances across pairs of environments


<!-- rnb-text-end -->


<!-- rnb-chunk-begin -->


<!-- rnb-source-begin  -->

```r
```r
if(!exists(\cov_pdiffs\)){
  cov_pdiffs <- as.matrix(read.table(\/global/scratch/users/milesroberts/moi_lab_projects/grenenet-phase2/data/unbiased_increment_covariances.tsv\, header = TRUE, row.names = 1))
  colnames(cov_pdiffs) <- gsub(\X\, \\, colnames(cov_pdiffs))
}

sites <- unique(gsub(\_.*\, \\, colnames(cov_pdiffs)))

row_site <- gsub(\_.*\, \\, rownames(cov_pdiffs))
col_site <- gsub(\_.*\, \\, colnames(cov_pdiffs))

row_rep <- gsub(\_.*_\, \\, rownames(cov_pdiffs))
col_rep <- gsub(\_.*_\, \\, colnames(cov_pdiffs))

pair_gt_results = NULL

for(i in 1:(length(sites) - 1)){
  a = sites[i]
  for(j in (i+1):length(sites)){
    
    b = sites[j]
    
    print(paste(\Sites:\, i, j))
    
    # subset cov to site pair
    cov_pair <- cov_pdiffs[row_site == a, col_site == b]
    
    # remove overlapping increments
    sub_row_rep <- gsub(\_.*_\, \\, rownames(cov_pair))
    sub_col_rep <- gsub(\_.*_\, \\, colnames(cov_pair))
  
    sub_row_site <- gsub(\_.*\, \\, rownames(cov_pair))
    sub_col_site <- gsub(\_.*\, \\, colnames(cov_pair))
  
    sub_row_gen <- gsub(\_\, \\, str_extract(rownames(cov_pair), \_.*_\))
    sub_col_gen <- gsub(\_\, \\, str_extract(colnames(cov_pair), \_.*_\))
    
    # covariances across reps, non-overlapping increments
    total_covar <- 0
    for(k in colnames(cov_pair)){
      col_gen <- gsub(\_\, \\, str_extract(k, \_.*_\))
      cov_k <- cov_pair[sub_row_gen != col_gen, k]
      total_covar <- total_covar + 2*sum(cov_k)
    }
    
    a_b_reps <- unique(c(sub_row_rep, sub_col_rep))
    total_var <- 0
    nreps <- 0
    for(k in a_b_reps){
      cov_k <- cov_pdiffs[k == row_rep, k == col_rep]
      total_var <- total_var + sum(cov_k)
      nreps <- nreps + 1
    }
    
    npairs = length(unique(sub_row_rep))*length(unique(sub_col_rep))
    
    pair_gt_result = data.frame(site_a = a,
                                site_b = b,
                      nreps = nreps,
                      npairs = npairs,
                      total_covar = total_covar,
                      total_var = total_var,
                      mean_covar = total_covar/npairs,
                      mean_var = total_var/nreps
                      )
    
    pair_gt_results = rbind(pair_gt_results, pair_gt_result)
    
  }
}

pair_gt_results$ge_t <- pair_gt_results$mean_covar/pair_gt_results$mean_var

pair_gt_results_clim <- merge(pair_gt_results, worldclim_sitesdata, by.x = \site_a\, by.y = \site\)

pair_gt_results_clim <- merge(pair_gt_results_clim, worldclim_sitesdata, by.x = \site_b\, by.y = \site\, suffixes = c(\_a\, \_b\))

pair_gt_results_clim$delta_bio1 <- (pair_gt_results_clim$bio1_a - pair_gt_results_clim$bio1_b)

ggplot(pair_gt_results_clim, aes(x = delta_bio1, y = ge_t)) +
  geom_point()

```r
```r

if(!exists(\pdiffs\)){
  pdiffs <- fread(\/global/scratch/users/milesroberts/moi_lab_projects/grenenet-phase2/data/allele_frequency_increments.csv\, header = T)

  #pdiffs <- fread(\/global/scratch/users/milesroberts/moi_lab_projects/grenenet-phase2/data/allele_frequency_increments.csv\, header = T, select = c(\1_1_1\, \1_2_1\, \1_3_1\, \1_1_2\, \1_2_2\, \1_3_2\, \1_1_3\, \1_2_3\, \1_3_3\, \1_1_4\, \1_2_4\, \1_3_4\))
}

sign_permute_replicates <- 200

sign_permute_blocks <- create_blocks(gen0, X1, X2, 15000, \_\)

pdiffs$window = sign_permute_blocks$window

rm(sign_permute_blocks)
gc()

# make list of sites
sites <- unique(gsub(\_.*\, \\, colnames(pdiffs)))
sites <- sites[c(-31)]

#
output_gt_perm <- paste(results_path, \gt_abs_permutations.txt\, sep = \\)

# create permutations of allele frequency changes by site
mean_gt_perms = NULL
# subset to one site
for (site in sites) {
  print(paste(\Site:\, site))
  pdiffs_site <- pdiffs %>%
    dplyr::select(starts_with(paste(site, \_\, sep = \\)), window)
  # now permute many times
  for (p in 1:sign_permute_replicates) {
    # subset to one rep
    print(paste(\Replicate:\, p))
    # choose a random replicate
    # within a block, randomly multiply allele frequency change by +1 or -1
    pdiffs_perm <- pdiffs_site %>%
      group_by(window) %>%
      mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ .x * sample(c(1, -1), size = 1))) %>%
      ungroup() %>%
      dplyr::select(-window)
    
    gt_perms = NULL
    # loop over each replicate
    for (exprep in 1:12) {
      pdiffs_perm_rep <- pdiffs_perm %>%
        dplyr::select(ends_with(paste(\_\, exprep, sep = \\)))
      
      if (ncol(pdiffs_perm_rep) <= 1) {
        #print(\Need at least two increments. Skipping to next replicate...\)
        next
      }
      
      # un-corrected covariance matrices
      cov_pdiffs_perm <- cov(pdiffs_perm_rep)
      
      # TO-DO: correct covariance matrices
      
      # calculate covariance rolling sums
      gt_perm <- gt_from_covmat(cov_pdiffs_perm)
      
      # save result
      gt_perm$rep <- exprep
      gt_perms <- rbind(gt_perms, gt_perm)
    }
    
    # average across replicates to get one permutation sample
    if(is.null(gt_perms)){
      next
    }
    
    mean_gt_perm = gt_perms %>%
      group_by(gen) %>%
      summarize(
        gt = mean(sum_cov) / mean(sum_cov + sum_var),
        gt_abs = mean(sum_abs_cov) / mean(sum_abs_cov + sum_var),
        sum_cov = mean(sum_cov),
        sum_abs_cov = mean(sum_abs_cov),
        sum_pos_cov = mean(sum_pos_cov),
        sum_neg_cov = mean(sum_neg_cov),
        sum_var = mean(sum_var),
        ratio = mean(ratio, na.rm = T),
        n = n()
      )
    
    mean_gt_perm$perm = p
    mean_gt_perm$site = site
    
    write.table(mean_gt_perm, output_gt_perm, col.names=!file.exists(output_gt_perm), append = T, row.names = F, sep = \

sites <- unique(gsub(\_.*\, \\, colnames(hapfire)))
sites <- sites[c(-30,-32)]

conv_cor_blocks <- create_blocks(gen0, X1, X2, 15000, \_\)

hapfire$window = conv_cor_blocks$window

output_conv_cor <- paste(\/global/scratch/users/milesroberts/moi_lab_projects/grenenet-phase2/results/\, today, \/convergence_correlation_first_increment_by_block.tsv\, sep = \\)

for(w in unique(hapfire$window)){
  print(paste(\Window:\, w))
  hap_block <- hapfire %>% filter(window == w)
  gen0_block <- conv_cor_blocks %>% filter(window == w)
  for (i in seq_along(sites)) {
    a <- sites[i]
    hap_site_a <- hap_block %>% 
      dplyr::select(starts_with(paste(a, \_1_\, sep = \\)))
    print(paste(\Site:\, a))
    for (j in seq_len(length(sites))[-seq_len(i)]) {
      b <- sites[j]
      hap_site_b <- hap_block %>% 
        dplyr::select(starts_with(paste(b, \_1_\, sep = \\)))

      # calculate covariances across sites
      conv_cor_result <- covmat_pop_pair(hap_site_a, 
                      hap_site_b, 
                      paste(\^\, a, \_\, sep = \\), 
                      paste(\^\, b, \_\, sep = \\), 
                      gen0_block$X3)
      
      conv_cor_row <- data.frame(
        window = w,
        site_a = a,
        site_b = b,
        conv_cor = conv_cor_result
      )
      
      append_table(conv_cor_row, output_conv_cor)
    }
  }
}

      conv_cor_numer = conv_cor[1],

    time_labels <- gsub(\_\, \\, str_extract(colnames(pdiffs_site), \_.*_\))

          site = site,

        ),

      append_table(rep_gt_row, output_rep_gt)
    }
}

## sign-permuted null distribution


<!-- rnb-text-end -->


<!-- rnb-chunk-begin -->


<!-- rnb-source-begin  -->

```r
```r

if(!exists(\pdiffs\)){
  pdiffs <- fread(\/global/scratch/users/milesroberts/moi_lab_projects/grenenet-phase2/data/allele_frequency_increments.csv\, header = T)
}

# Number of sign permutations
perms <- 50

# loop over pairs of sites
sites <- unique(gsub(\_.*\, \\, colnames(pdiffs)))
rep_gt_blocks <- create_blocks(gen0, X1, X2, 15000, \_\)
pdiffs$window = rep_gt_blocks$window

output_rep_gt_perm <- paste(\/global/scratch/users/milesroberts/moi_lab_projects/grenenet-phase2/results/\, today, \/replicate_gt_by_block_wn_env_permutations.tsv\, sep = \\)

for (site in sites) {
  
  print(paste(\Site:\, site))
  
  pdiffs_site <- pdiffs %>% 
    dplyr::select(starts_with(paste(site, \_\, sep = \\)), window)
  
  rep_labels <- gsub(\.*_\, \\, colnames(pdiffs_site))
  rep_labels <- rep_labels[-length(rep_labels)]
  
  time_labels <- gsub(\_\, \\, str_extract(colnames(pdiffs_site), \_.*_\))
  time_labels <- time_labels[-length(time_labels)]
  
  if( (length(unique(time_labels)) <= 2) | (length(unique(rep_labels)) <= 2)){
    print(\Too few time points or replicates. Skipping to next site...\)
    next
  }
  
  for(w in unique(pdiffs$window)){
    pdiffs_block <- pdiffs_site %>% filter(window == w) %>% dplyr::select(-window)
    
    for(perm in 1:perms){
      
      # draw whether an increment will be flipped or not 
      sign_permutations <- sample(c(-1,1), size = ncol(pdiffs_block), replace = T)
      
      # Create the diagonal matrix from vector
      P <- diag(sign_permutations)
      
      # Perform matrix multiplication to flip all increments at once
      pdiffs_block_perm <- as.matrix(pdiffs_block) %*% P
      
      # calculate replicate G(t)
      rep_gt <- replicate_gt(pdiffs_block_perm, rep_labels, time_labels)
      
      # save results
      rep_gt_row <- cbind(
        data.frame(
          window = w,
          site = site,
          perm = perm,
          S = nrow(pdiffs_block)
        ),
        rep_gt)
      
      append_table(rep_gt_row, output_rep_gt_perm)
    }
  }
}

rep_gt_perm <- read.table(\/global/scratch/users/milesroberts/moi_lab_projects/grenenet-phase2/results/2026-06-13/replicate_gt_by_block_wn_env_permutations.tsv\, sep = \

# G(t) curves including SVs

kMate class matrices: per-record ALT allele frequencies for SNPs and structural
variants, estimated from pooled sequencing against the 231-founder pangenome
panel (`resources/class_matrices/` on Savio). Rows are pools (`site` × `plot`,
flower-weighted merge of collection timepoints), columns are records. Gen0 is
the founding seed mix (8 reps). Here we compute gt curves per pool with
`covmat_from_pmat()` + `gt_from_covmat()`, treating the 8 seed-mix reps'
average as the gen0 column and gen1-5 as subsequent time points.

# randomly swith which allele is being tracked
# right now, the non-reference allele is always the one we're tracking
idx <- sample(c(T,F), size = nrow(gen0), replace = T)
gen0[idx,"X0_0_0"] <- 1 - gen0[idx,"X0_0_0"]

write.csv(gen0, "/global/scratch/users/milesroberts/moi_lab_projects/grenenet-phase2/data/PHASE_1_2_COMBINED_kmate_allele_frequency_seedmix_randswitch.csv", quote = F, row.names = F)

process_one_minus <- function(idx, chunk_size, output) {
  function(x, pos) {
    print(pos)
    print(Sys.time())
    # calculate end
    chunk_size <- nrow(x)
    end <- pos + chunk_size - 1
    # subtract 1 from some alleles
    print(paste("Start:", pos, "End:", end))
    idx_sub <- idx[pos:end]
    x[idx_sub,] <- 1 - x[idx_sub,]
    write.table(x, output, col.names=!file.exists(output), append = T, row.names = F, sep = ",", quote = F)
  }
}

# phase 1
read_csv_chunked(
  "/global/scratch/users/milesroberts/moi_lab_projects/grenenet-phase2/data/PHASE_1_2_COMBINED_kmate_allele_frequency_trays.csv",

    process_one_minus(
      idx,

## ONE-TIME: drop allele frequencies near absorbing boundaries

kmate allele frequencies all seem to start within the absorbing boundaries, so there's little point in scanning through the allele frequency matrix to remove frequencies.


<!-- rnb-text-end -->


<!-- rnb-chunk-begin -->


<!-- rnb-source-begin  -->

```r
```r
# loop over site - replicate combinations
# remove allele frequency trajectory after first fixation/loss 
sites <- unique(gsub(\_.*\, \\, colnames(hapfire)))
hapfire_nas <- NULL
for(site in unique(sites)){
  print(paste(\Site:\, site))
  hap_site <- hapfire %>% 
    dplyr::select(starts_with(paste(site, \_\, sep = \\)))
  for(exprep in 1:12){
    print(paste(\Rep:\, exprep))
    print(\Loading data for replicate...\)
    hap_rep <- hap_site %>% 
      dplyr::select(ends_with(paste(\_\, exprep, sep = \\))) %>%
      collect()
    
    # remove variants that are NA in seedmix
    print(\Removing variants fixed in seedmix...\)
    hap_rep <- hap_rep[non_abosrbing_freq,]
    
    # omit allele frequencies that later reach absorbing boundaries
    # it is possible that measurement errors cause frequency to reach 1 and then come back down
    # print(\Removing measurements near absorbing boundaries...\)
    # hap_rep[(hap_rep < 1/231) | (hap_rep > 1 - 1/231)] <- NA
    
    # sort names to be in order of generation
    print(\Sorting columns...\)
    hap_rep <- hap_rep %>% 
      relocate(all_of(sort(colnames(hap_rep))))
    
    print(\Removing NAs...\)
    if(ncol(hap_rep) > 1){
      hap_rep_na <- t(apply(hap_rep, MARGIN = 1, rm_na_after_na))
      colnames(hap_rep_na) <- colnames(hap_rep)
    } else {
      hap_rep_na <- hap_rep
    }
    hapfire_nas <- cbind(hapfire_nas, hap_rep_na)
    rm(hap_rep_na, hap_rep); gc()
  }
}

## feder t-test


<!-- rnb-text-end -->


<!-- rnb-chunk-begin -->


<!-- rnb-source-begin  -->

```r
for(this_site in unique(sites)){
  print(paste("Processing site", this_site, "..."))
  feder_summary <- feder_kmate_parquet %>%
    #slice_head(n = 1000) %>%
    filter(!is.na(yi), site == as.integer(this_site)) %>%
    collect() %>%
    group_by(site, chrom, pos) %>% 
    #distinct(chrom, pos, rep, pool, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
    summarize(ybar = mean(yi), 
              s2 = var(yi),
              n = n()) %>%
    mutate(tvalue = ybar/sqrt(s2/n),
           pvalue = 2*pt(abs(tvalue), df = n - 1, lower.tail = F)) %>%
    left_join(gen0[,c("chrom", "pos", "class")], by = c("chrom", "pos")) %>%
    mutate(highlight = ifelse(class == "sv", "yes", "no")) %>% 
    rename(CHROM = chrom, POS = pos)

  print(paste("Plotting site", this_site, "..."))
  man_test <- plot_manhattan(feder_summary, title = paste0("Site ", this_site))
  ggsave(paste0("/global/scratch/users/milesroberts/moi_lab_projects/grenenet-phase2/results/",today,"/feder_t_test_kmate_site_", this_site, ".png"), man_test, width = 9, height = 5)
  fwrite(feder_summary, feder_t_test_summary_file, col.names = !file.exists(feder_t_test_summary_file), row.names = F, sep = ",", quote = F, append = T)
  rm(feder_summary, man_test); gc(verbose = FALSE)
}

```

## gt curves - bootstrap intervals


<!-- rnb-text-end -->


<!-- rnb-chunk-begin -->


<!-- rnb-source-begin  -->

```r
# loop over sites
for (cls in var_class_loop_list) {
  
  print(paste(Sys.time(), "- Looping for variant class: ", paste(cls, collapse = "_"), "..."))
  
  cls_idx <- gen0 %>% 
    mutate(row_idx = row_number()) %>% 
    filter(class %in% cls) %>%
    pull(row_idx)
  
  # subset to variant class
  gen0_cls <- gen0 %>%
    filter(row_number() %in% cls_idx)
  
  for (site in unique(sites)[10:31]) {
    print(paste(Sys.time(), "- Site:", site))
    hap_site <- hapfire %>% 
      dplyr::select(starts_with(paste(site, "_", sep = "")))
    
    for (exprep in 1:12) {
      print(paste(Sys.time(), "- Rep:", exprep))
      hap_rep <- hap_site %>%
        dplyr::select(ends_with(paste("_", exprep, sep = ""))) %>%
        collect() %>%
        mutate(window = blocks$window) %>% # add block ids
        filter(row_number() %in% cls_idx) # subset to variant class

      # sort names to be in order of generation
      hap_rep <- hap_rep %>%
        relocate(all_of(sort(colnames(hap_rep))))
      
      if (ncol(hap_rep) < 2) {
        print("Need at least two increments. Skipping to next replicate...")
        next
      }
      
      rep_n <- grab_sample_sizes(flower_counts, pool, colnames(hap_rep), 10000, total_flowers)
      
      hap_rep <- cbind(gen0_cls$X0_0_0, hap_rep)
      colnames(hap_rep)[1] = paste(site, "_0_", exprep, sep = "")
      
      for(b in 1:num_block_boots){
        
        if(b %% 25 == 0){
          print(paste(Sys.time(), "- Bootstraps done:", b))
        }
        
        hap_boot <- hap_rep %>%
          nest(data = -window) %>% 
          slice_sample(n = num_blocks, replace = TRUE) %>% 
          #mutate(new_group_id = row_number()) %>% 
          unnest(cols = c(data))  %>%
          select(-window) %>% 
          as.data.frame()
        
        covmat <- covmat_from_pmat(
          hap_boot,
          rep_n$total_flowers*2,
          correct_for_n = T,
          input_asin_trans = F
        )
        
        # covlong <- covmat %>% 
        #   as.data.frame() %>% 
        #   rownames_to_column(var = "A") %>% 
        #   pivot_longer(cols = -A, names_to = "B", values_to = "cov")
        # 
        # covlong$site <- site
        # covlong$rep <- exprep
        # covlong$block <- w
        # covlong$weight <- nrow(hap_wind)
        # append_table(covlong, output_gt_class_blocks)
        
        gt_result <- gt_from_covmat(covmat)
        gt_result$site = site
        gt_result$rep = exprep
        gt_result$boot = b
        gt_result$class = paste(cls, collapse = "_")
        gt_result$weight = nrow(hap_boot)
        append_table(gt_result, output_gt_kmate_blocks)
        
        rm(gt_result, hap_boot); gc()
      }
      rm(hap_rep); gc()
    }
    rm(hap_site); gc()
  }
}  

```

## ONE-TIME: calculate block bootstraps


<!-- rnb-text-end -->


<!-- rnb-chunk-begin -->


<!-- rnb-source-begin  -->

```r
gt_kmate_blocks <- fread("/global/scratch/users/milesroberts/moi_lab_projects/grenenet-phase2/results/2026-09-17/gt_blocks_kmate_long.tsv")

#### Point estimates ####

gt_from_blocked_long_varcov <- function(data) {
  
# 1. Pool across blocks, KEEP SIGN (no abs here)
gt_mean_cov <- data %>%
  group_by(A, B, site, rep) %>%
  summarise(mean_cov = sum(weight * cov) / sum(weight), .groups = "drop")

parse_time <- function(x) as.integer(str_split_fixed(x, "_", 3)[, 2])

vcov_long <- gt_mean_cov %>%
  mutate(time_A = parse_time(A), time_B = parse_time(B))

# 2. V(g): diagonal terms (variance is already positive)
V_tab <- vcov_long %>%
  filter(time_A == time_B) %>%
  transmute(site, rep, g = time_A, V = mean_cov)

# 3. C(g): every EARLIER interval paired with g, summed with sign, per (site, rep, g)
C_tab <- vcov_long %>%
  filter(time_A != time_B) %>%
  group_by(site, rep, g = pmax(time_A, time_B)) %>%
  summarise(C = sum(mean_cov), .groups = "drop")  # both directions included -> natural factor of 2

# 4. Combine, abs() exactly once per g, then cumulate
G_tab <- full_join(V_tab, C_tab, by = c("site", "rep", "g")) %>%
  arrange(site, rep, g) %>%
  group_by(site, rep) %>%
  mutate(
    V       = replace_na(V, 0),
    absC    = abs(replace_na(C, 0)),   # abs applied once, after summing same-g pairs
    cumV    = cumsum(V),
    cumAbsC = cumsum(absC),
    G       = cumAbsC / (cumV + cumAbsC)
  ) %>%
  complete(g = 1:max(g), fill = list(V = 0, absC = 0, cumV = 0, cumAbsC = 0, G = 0)) %>%
  ungroup() 
  

return(G_tab)

}

gt_point_est <- gt_from_blocked_long_varcov(gt_kmate_blocks)

ggplot(gt_point_est, aes(x = factor(g), y = G, group = rep)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_line() +
  facet_wrap(~site, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(x = "Generation", y = "Gabs(t)")

ggsave(paste0("../results/by-date/", today, "/g_abs_pooled.pdf"), width = 9 , height = 9)


#### Block bootstraps ####
boot_once <- function(data, i) {
  data %>%
    group_by(site, rep, A, B) %>%
    slice_sample(prop = 1, replace = TRUE) %>%
    gt_from_blocked_long_varcov() %>%
    mutate(boot_id = i)
  }

n_boot <- 1000
boot_results <- map_dfr(1:n_boot, ~boot_once(gt_kmate_blocks, .x))

boot_summary <- boot_results %>%
  group_by(site, rep, g) %>%
  summarize(q025 = quantile(G, 0.025),
            q975 = quantile(G, 0.975)) %>%
  left_join(gt_point_est, by = c("site", "rep", "g")) %>%
  mutate(lci = 2*G - q975,
         uci = 2*G - q025,
         lci = if_else(lci < 0, 0, lci),
         uci = if_else(uci > 1, 1, uci))

write.csv(boot_results, "/global/scratch/users/milesroberts/moi_lab_projects/grenenet-phase2/results/2026-09-17/gt_blocks_bootstrap_kmate.tsv", quote = F, row.names = F)

write.csv(boot_summary, "/global/scratch/users/milesroberts/moi_lab_projects/grenenet-phase2/results/2026-09-17/gt_blocks_bootstrap_summary_kmate.tsv", quote = F, row.names = F)

```r
  for (site in unique(sites)[10:31]) {
    print(paste("Site:", site))
    hap_site <- hapfire %>% 
      dplyr::select(starts_with(paste(site, "_", sep = "")))
    
    for (exprep in 1:12) {
      print(paste("Rep:", exprep))
      hap_rep <- hap_site %>%
        dplyr::select(ends_with(paste("_", exprep, sep = ""))) %>%
        collect() %>%
        mutate(window = blocks$window) %>% # add block ids
        filter(row_number() %in% cls_idx) # subset to variant class
      
      #hap_rep$window <- blocks$window
      
      # sort names to be in order of generation
      hap_rep <- hap_rep %>%
        relocate(all_of(sort(colnames(hap_rep))))
      
      if (ncol(hap_rep) < 3) {
        print("Need at least two increments. Skipping to next replicate...")
        next
      }
      
      rep_n <- grab_sample_sizes(flower_counts, pool, colnames(hap_rep), 10000, total_flowers)
      
      hap_rep <- cbind(gen0_cls$X0_0_0, hap_rep)
      colnames(hap_rep)[1] = paste(site, "_0_", exprep, sep = "")
      
      for(p in num_perm){
        
        covmat <- covmat_from_pmat(
          pmat = hap_rep %>% select(-window),
          n = rep_n$total_flowers*2,
          correct_for_n = T,
          input_asin_trans = F,
          procedure = "window",
          windows = hap_rep %>% pull(window)
        )
        
        gt_result <- gt_from_covmat(covmat)
        
        gt_result$site = site
        gt_result$rep = exprep
        # gt_result$block = w
        # gt_result$weight = nrow(hap_wind)
        gt_result$perm = p
        
        append_table(gt_result, output_gt_kmate_perms)
        rm(gt_result, covmat); gc()
      }
      rm(hap_rep); gc()
    }
    rm(hap_site); gc()
  }

id_cols <- c("chrom", "start", "end", "gene")

recom_map_3 <- data.frame(

recom_map_4 <- data.frame(

)

recom_map_4$cm <- recom_map_4$cm - min(recom_map_4$cm)

# 5

## LD decay

<!-- rnb-text-end -->


<!-- rnb-chunk-begin -->


<!-- rnb-source-begin  -->

```r

# LD decay threshold
threshold <- 0.1
  
# define blocks within which to calculate LD decay
# helps contextualize blocks for other analyses
ld_decay_blocks <- create_blocks(gen0, X1, X2, 15000, "_")

output_ld_decay <- paste0("/global/scratch/users/milesroberts/moi_lab_projects/grenenet-phase2/results/", today, "/ld_decay_by_block.txt", sep = "")

check_file_exists(output_ld_decay)

# Loop over each block and calculate LD decay within the block
for(w in unique(ld_decay_blocks$window)) {
  cat(w, "\n")
  
  block_coords <- ld_decay_blocks %>%
    filter(window == w) %>%
    summarize(chrom = unique(X1),
              start = min(X2),
              end = max(X2))
  
  chrom = block_coords$chrom
  start = block_coords$start
  end   = block_coords$end
  
  # extract test region
  ld_region <- ld_matrix %>%
    filter(
      (CHR_A == chrom) &
        (BP_A >= start) &
        (BP_A <= end) &
        (CHR_B == chrom) &
        (BP_B >= start) &
        (BP_B <= end)
    ) %>%
    mutate(d = BP_B - BP_A, n = 231) %>%
    collect()
  
  # Fit Hill and Weir Non-Linear Least Squares (NLS) Model
  hw_model <- nls(
    R2 ~ hill_weir_r2(d, n, C),
    data = ld_region,
    start = list(C = 0.001),
    control = nls.control(maxiter = 1000, warnOnly = TRUE)
  )
  
  # Extract the fitted recombination parameter (C)
  fitted_C <- coef(hw_model)["C"]
  line1 <- paste("Estimated 4Nc:", signif(fitted_C,3), "\n")
  
  # Generate Predicted Trend Line Values
  pred_distances <- seq(0, max(ld_region$d), length.out = 1000)
  pred_r2 <- predict(hw_model, newdata = data.frame(d = pred_distances, n = 231))
  plot_data <- data.frame(d = pred_distances, R2 = pred_r2)
  
  # Calculate LD Decay Distance at r^2 threshold (e.g., r2 = 0.2)
  decay_distance <- pred_distances[which.min(abs(pred_r2 - threshold))]
  line2 <- paste("LD decays to r^2 =",
      threshold,
      "at:",
      round(decay_distance / 1000, 2),
      "kb\n")
  
  line3 <- paste("Block coordinates: ", chrom, ":", start, "..", end, "\n", sep = "")
  
  # Plot the Raw Data Bins and the Fitted Hill & Weir Curve
  ggplot(ld_region, aes(x = d, y = R2)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.3, color = "darkgray", shape = 16) +
    geom_line(
      data = plot_data,
      aes(x = d, y = R2),
      color = "skyblue",
      size = 1.2
    ) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = threshold,
               linetype = "dashed",
               color = "pink") +
    geom_vline(xintercept = decay_distance,
               linetype = "dashed",
               color = "pink") +
    labs(title = paste(line1,line2,line3, sep = ""), x = "Physical Distance (bp)", y = "LD (r^2)")
  
    ggsave(paste(results_path, "ld_decay_", chrom, "_", start, "_", end, ".png", sep = ""), width = 5.5, height = 6)
    gc()
    
    # save summary to table
    ld_decay_result <- data.frame(
      chrom = chrom,
      start = start,
      end = end,
      block = w,
      C = fitted_C,
      decay_threshold = threshold,
      decay_distance = decay_distance,
               )
    append_table(ld_decay_result, output_ld_decay)
}

```

## compile diversity values


<!-- rnb-text-end -->


<!-- rnb-chunk-begin -->


<!-- rnb-source-begin  -->

```r
# now loop over diversity files
pi_files <- list.files(path = "../data/diversity", recursive = T, full.names = T, pattern = "_pi.txt$")

file_prefixes <- gsub("/", "_", gsub("../data/diversity/|.txt", "", pi_files))

plot_list <- list()

pi_final <- NULL

for(i in seq_along(pi_files)){
  
  pi_file <- pi_files[i]
  
  cat(paste0("Processing ", pi_file, "...\n"))
  
  nuc_div <- fread(pi_file, header = T)

  # calculate window midpoint
  nuc_div$window_pos_mid <- (nuc_div$window_pos_2 + nuc_div$window_pos_1 + 1)/2
  nuc_div$window_pos_mid <- nuc_div$window_pos_mid/1e6 #per mb
  
  # match chromosome name across files
  names(nuc_div)[2] <- "chrom"
  
  # extract number of individuals in vcf
  num_indiv <- as.numeric(gsub("_pi.txt", "", str_split(pi_file, "/")[[1]][5]))
  site_class <- str_split(pi_file, "/")[[1]][4]
  
  # if diversity file excludes invariant sites, rescale denominator
  # count_comparisons = choose(<number of diploid individuals>*2,2)*no_sites
  if( ((num_indiv == 231 | num_indiv == 2029) & (site_class == "all_sites")) | (site_class == "no_invar") ){
    cat("Rescaling pi denominator to assume all missing sites are invariant...\n")
    nuc_div$count_comparisons <- choose(num_indiv*2,2)*(nuc_div$window_pos_2 - nuc_div$window_pos_1 + 1)
    nuc_div$avg_pi <- nuc_div$count_diffs/nuc_div$count_comparisons
  }
  
  if( (num_indiv == 231 | num_indiv == 2029) & (site_class != "all_sites") ){
    nuc_div$avg_pi <- nuc_div$count_diffs/(nuc_div$count_comparisons+nuc_div$count_missing)
  }
  
  nuc_div$site_class <- site_class
  nuc_div$num_indiv <- num_indiv
  
  pi_final <- rbind(pi_final, nuc_div)
}

```

<!-- rnb-source-end -->

<!-- rnb-chunk-end -->

## Diversity vs recombination rate


<!-- rnb-text-end -->


<!-- rnb-chunk-begin -->


<!-- rnb-source-begin  -->

```r

# fit model to marey map
best_mods <- recom_map %>%
  group_by(chrom) %>%
  nest() %>%
  mutate(model = purrr::map(data, ~ find_best_poly(.x, 
                                                   x_col = "pos",
                                                   y_col = "cm", 
                                                   max_degree = 7)))
# Plot model fits
grid_data <- best_mods %>%
  mutate(
    grid = purrr::map(data, ~ tibble(x_val = seq(min(.x$pos), max(.x$pos), length.out = 500))))

pred_data <- grid_data %>% 
  mutate(fit  = purrr::map2(model, grid, ~ predict(.x, newdata = .y))
  ) %>%
  select(chrom, grid, fit) %>%
  unnest(c(grid, fit))

names(pred_data)[2] = "pos"

ggplot(pred_data, aes(x = pos, y = fit)) +
  geom_point(data = recom_map, mapping = aes(x = pos, y = cm), shape = 16) +
  geom_line(color = "red") +
  facet_wrap(.~chrom, scales = "free", labeller = as_labeller(function(value) paste0("Chromosome ", value))) +
  labs(x = "Physical position (Mb)", y = "Genetic position (cM)")

ggsave(paste(results_path, "marey_map_fitted.pdf", sep = ""), width = 7, height = 6)


# Evaluate derivative of model for windows
  rate_vs_div <- pi_final %>%
    left_join(best_mods, by = "chrom") %>%
    group_by(chrom) %>%
    mutate(rate = eval_deriv(model[[1]], window_pos_mid)) %>%
    select(chrom, window_pos_1, window_pos_2, window_pos_mid, rate, avg_pi, site_class, num_indiv) %>%
    unnest(cols = c(rate))
  
  # filter out negative recombination rates
  rate_vs_div <- rate_vs_div %>% filter(rate > 0)
  
  # recombination rate across chromosome
  ggplot(subset(rate_vs_div, site_class == "all_sites" & num_indiv == 1135), aes(x = window_pos_mid, y = rate)) +
    geom_line() +
    facet_wrap(.~chrom) +
    labs(x = "Position (bp)", y = "Recombination rate (cM/Mb)")
  
  ggsave(paste(results_path, "recombination_rate.pdf", sep = ""))
  
  # correlation between recombination rate and diversity
  corr_results <- rate_vs_div %>%
    group_by(site_class, num_indiv) %>%
    filter(rate <= 10) %>%
    reframe(corr_ci = list(corr_ci_autocorr(rate, avg_pi)))

# 2. Create all unique combinations
combinations <- crossing(x = c("all_sites", "zero_fold", "four_fold"), y = c(1135, 2029, 231))

# 3. Loop over them using a function
plot_list <- pmap(combinations, function(x, y) {
  print(paste("site_class:", x, "| num_indiv:", y))
  
  # subset corr results
  corr_result <- corr_results[(corr_results$site_class == x) & (corr_results$num_indiv == y), 3][[1]][[1]]
  
   # build plot title
   title <- paste0(gsub("_", " ", x), 
                   ", ", 
                   y,
                  "\nr = ", 
                  signif(corr_result$r, 2), 
                  ", p = ", 
                  format.pval(corr_result$p_value, digits = 2, eps = 0.001), 
                  "\n95 % CI = [", 
                  signif(corr_result$ci_lower, 2), 
                  ", ", 
                  signif(corr_result$ci_upper, 2), 
                  "]")
  
  # diversity vs recombination rate
  plotdata <- rate_vs_div %>%
    filter((site_class == x) & (num_indiv == y))
  
  plot_rate_div <- ggplot(plotdata, aes(x = rate, y = avg_pi)) +
    geom_point() +
    #geom_smooth(method = "lm", color = "lightblue") + 
    #stat_cor() +
    #xlim(0, 10) +
    geom_smooth(
      data = subset(plotdata, rate <= 10), 
      method = "lm", 
      se = TRUE, 
      color = "lightblue"
    ) +
    facet_zoom(rate <= 10) +
    theme(
      # Draws a border line and shaded region for the connecting zoom lines
      zoom = element_rect(colour = "pink", linewidth = 0.8, fill = alpha("pink", 0.01))) +
    labs(x = "Recombination rate (cM/Mb)", 
         y = "Average nucleotide diversity",
         title = title)
  
  ggsave(paste0(results_path, x, "_", y,"_recombination_vs_diversity.pdf", sep = ""), plot_rate_div, width = 5.5, height = 8)
  
  plot_rate_div # pmap automatically makes list of whatever iterations output
  
})


# adjust plots to fit them all together
plot_list <- purrr::map(plot_list, ~ .x + theme(text = element_text(size = 12)))

ggarrange(plot_list[[1]], plot_list[[2]], plot_list[[3]], nrow = 1, ncol = 3)
ggsave(paste0(results_path, "/all_sites_recombionation_rate_vs_diversity.pdf"), width = 9, height = 5)

ggarrange(plot_list[[4]], plot_list[[5]], plot_list[[6]], nrow = 1, ncol = 3)
ggsave(paste0(results_path, "/four_fold_recombionation_rate_vs_diversity.pdf"), width = 9, height = 5)

ggarrange(plot_list[[7]], plot_list[[8]], plot_list[[9]], nrow = 1, ncol = 3)
ggsave(paste0(results_path, "/zero_fold_recombionation_rate_vs_diversity.pdf"), width = 9, height = 5)

```r

#gene_density <- fread("/global/scratch/users/milesroberts/genomes/arabidopsis_thaliana/cds_per_window.bed")
gene_density <- fread("/global/scratch/users/milesroberts/genomes/arabidopsis_thaliana/pi_windows_with_cds_counts.bed")

names(gene_density) <- c("chrom", "window_pos_1", "window_pos_2", "chrom_b", "window_pos_1_b", "window_pos_2_b","n_cds")

gene_density$chrom <- as.integer(gene_density$chrom)

gene_density <- gene_density %>%
  group_by(chrom, window_pos_1, window_pos_2) %>%
  summarize(n_cds = sum(n_cds))

gene_density$frac_cds <- gene_density$n_cds/(gene_density$window_pos_2 - gene_density$window_pos_1 + 1)
#gene_density$window_pos_1 <- gene_density$window_pos_1 + 1

pi_final_density <- pi_final %>%
  left_join(gene_density, by = c("chrom", "window_pos_1", "window_pos_2"))
  
# Evaluate derivative of model for windows
rate_vs_div <- pi_final_density %>%
    left_join(best_mods, by = "chrom") %>%
    group_by(chrom) %>%
    mutate(rate = eval_deriv(model[[1]], window_pos_mid)) %>%
    select(chrom, window_pos_1, window_pos_2, window_pos_mid, site_class, num_indiv, rate, avg_pi, frac_cds) %>%
    unnest(cols = c(rate))
  
  # filter out negative recombination rates
  rate_vs_div <- rate_vs_div %>% 
    filter(rate > 0)
 
# correlation between recombination rate and diversity
  corr_results <- rate_vs_div %>%
    group_by(site_class, num_indiv) %>%
    filter(rate <= 10 & frac_cds >= 0.2) %>%
    reframe(corr_ci = list(corr_ci_autocorr(frac_cds, avg_pi)))
 
 # 2. Create all unique combinations
combinations <- crossing(x = c("all_sites", "zero_fold", "four_fold"), y = c(1135, 2029, 231))

# 3. Loop over them using a function
plot_list <- pmap(combinations, function(x, y) {
  print(paste("site_class:", x, "| num_indiv:", y))
  
  # subset corr results
  corr_result <- corr_results[(corr_results$site_class == x) & (corr_results$num_indiv == y), 3][[1]][[1]]
  
   # build plot title
   title <- paste0(gsub("_", " ", x), 
                   ", ", 
                   y,
                  "\nr = ", 
                  signif(corr_result$r, 2), 
                  ", p = ", 
                  format.pval(corr_result$p_value, digits = 2, eps = 0.001), 
                  "\n95 % CI = [", 
                  signif(corr_result$ci_lower, 2), 
                  ", ", 
                  signif(corr_result$ci_upper, 2), 
                  "]")
  
  # diversity vs recombination rate
  plotdata <- rate_vs_div %>%
    filter((site_class == x) & (num_indiv == y))
  
  plot_rate_div <- ggplot(plotdata, aes(x = frac_cds, y = avg_pi)) +
    geom_point() +
    #geom_smooth(method = "lm", color = "lightblue") + 
    #stat_cor() +
    #xlim(0, 10) +
    geom_smooth(
      data = subset(plotdata, frac_cds >= 0.2),
      method = "lm", 
      se = TRUE, 
      color = "lightblue"
    ) +
    facet_zoom(frac_cds >= 0.2) +
    theme(
      # Draws a border line and shaded region for the connecting zoom lines
      zoom = element_rect(colour = "pink", linewidth = 0.8, fill = alpha("pink", 0.01))) +
    labs(x = "CDS density", 
         y = "Average nucleotide diversity",
         title = title)
  
  ggsave(paste0(results_path, x, "_", y,"_cds_density_vs_diversity.pdf", sep = ""), plot_rate_div, width = 5.5, height = 8)
  
  plot_rate_div # pmap automatically makes list of whatever iterations output
})
  
# adjust plots to fit them all together
plot_list <- purrr::map(plot_list, ~ .x + theme(text = element_text(size = 12)))

ggarrange(plot_list[[1]], plot_list[[2]], plot_list[[3]], nrow = 1, ncol = 3)
ggsave(paste0(results_path, "/all_sites_cds_density_vs_diversity.pdf"), width = 9, height = 5)

# binned single-cell expression from workflow/expression_bins/
bin_files <- list.files("/global/scratch/users/milesroberts/moi_lab_projects/grenenet-phase2/workflow/results/expression_bins", pattern = "\\.bins$", full.names = TRUE)

# cell-type specificity (tau): 0 = ubiquitous, 1 = single cell type
tau <- function(x) {
  n <- length(x)
  if (n <= 1 || max(x) == 0) return(NA_real_)
  x <- x / max(x)
  sum(1 - x) / (n - 1)
}

# average of expression, conditioned on gene being expressed at all
mean_no_zeros <- function(x, thresh){
  y <- x[x > thresh]
  mean(y, na.rm = T)
}

# compile expression bins, calculate tau along genome
tau_bins <- NULL
exp_bins_long <- NULL
exp_bins_wide <- read.table(
  bin_files[1],
  check.names = FALSE,
  na.strings = c("NA", ".")
) %>%
  mutate(
    chrom = as.integer(gsub("Chr", "", V1)),
    window_pos_1 = V2 + 1,
    window_pos_2 = V3,
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(chrom, window_pos_1, window_pos_2)

for (f in bin_files) {
  sample <- gsub("\\.bins$", "", basename(f))
  bed <- paste0("/global/scratch/users/milesroberts/moi_lab_projects/grenenet-phase2/workflow/results/expression_bins/", sample, ".bed")
  cell_types <- readLines(bed, n = 1) %>%
    strsplit("\t") %>%
    unlist() %>%
    tail(-4)

  bins_wide <- read.table(f, col.names = c("chrom", "start", "end", cell_types),
                     check.names = FALSE, na.strings = c("NA", ".")) %>%
    mutate(chrom = as.integer(gsub("Chr", "", chrom)),
           window_pos_1 = start + 1,
           window_pos_2 = end,
           sample = sample) %>%
    mutate(across(all_of(cell_types), ~ replace_na(., 0))) %>%
    select(chrom, window_pos_1, window_pos_2, sample, all_of(cell_types))

   bins_long <- bins_wide %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = -c(chrom, window_pos_1, window_pos_2, sample), names_to = "cell_type", values_to = "cpm")
  
  bins_wide$tau <- apply(bins_wide[, cell_types, drop = FALSE], 1, tau)

  tau_bins <- rbind(tau_bins, bins_wide %>% select(chrom, window_pos_1, window_pos_2, sample, tau))
  
  exp_bins_long <- rbind(exp_bins_long, bins_long)
  
  exp_bins_wide <- cbind(exp_bins_wide, bins_wide[, cell_types, drop = FALSE])
}

exp_bins_wide$tau <- apply(exp_bins_wide[,-1:-3], 1, tau)
exp_bins_wide$avg_exp <- apply(exp_bins_wide[,-1:-3], 1, mean_no_zeros, thresh = 10)

exp_bins_wide<-exp_bins_wide %>%
  dplyr::select(chrom, window_pos_1, window_pos_2, tau, avg_exp) %>%
  filter(!is.na(chrom)) %>%
  mutate(window_pos_1 = window_pos_1 - 1,
    window_pos_mid = (window_pos_1+window_pos_2)/(2*1e6))

# combine expression bins with recombination rate, gene density, diversity
pi_windows_all <- rate_vs_div %>%
  left_join(exp_bins_wide, by = c("chrom", "window_pos_1", "window_pos_2"))

#### partial r-squared values ####
data_list <- split(pi_windows_all, list(pi_windows_all$site_class, pi_windows_all$num_indiv), drop = T)

# Map over the list, generate a standard plot for each subset, and print
rsq_results <- NULL
walk(data_list, function(sub_data) {
  
  mod <- eval(bquote(
    lm(avg_pi ~ I(avg_exp/frac_cds) + tau + frac_cds + rate, data = .(sub_data))
  ))
  
  rsq_out <- rsq.partial(mod)

  rsq_result <- as_tibble(rsq_out[c("variable", "partial.rsq")])
  
  rsq_result$site_class <- unique(sub_data$site_class)
  rsq_result$num_indiv <- unique(sub_data$num_indiv)
  
  rsq_results <<- rbind(rsq_results, rsq_result)

  print(unique(sub_data$site_class))
  print(unique(sub_data$num_indiv))
  print(rsq.partial(mod))

})
  
# visualize partial R-squared values
rsq_results <- rsq_results %>%
  mutate(site_class = recode(site_class,
                              "all_sites" = "All sites",
                              "four_fold" = "Four-fold degenerate",
                              "zero_fold" = "Zero-fold degenerate",
                             "no_invar" = "Invariant excluded"),
         variable = recode(variable,
                           "frac_cds" = "CDS density",
                           "tau" = "Specificity",
                           "rate" = "Recombination",
                           "I(avg_exp/frac_cds)" = "Mean expression"))

ggplot(rsq_results, aes(x = variable, y = partial.rsq)) +
  geom_col(color = "black", fill = "black") +
  #geom_text(aes(label = signif(partial.rsq,2)), vjust = -0.5) +

  geom_col() +

ggsave(paste0("../results/by-date/", today, "/tau_along_genome.pdf"), width = 7, height = 3)

# expression specificity vs average expression
ggplot(pi_windows_all  %>% filter(window_pos_2 %% 500000 == 0), aes(x = avg_exp, y = tau, color = factor(chrom))) +

ggsave(paste0("../results/by-date/", today, "/tau_vs_avg_expression.pdf"), width = 6, height = 4)

# expression specificity vs average expression, standardized by coding sequence density
ggplot(pi_windows_all  %>% filter(window_pos_2 %% 500000 == 0), aes(x = avg_exp/frac_cds, y = tau, color = factor(chrom))) +
  geom_point() +

ggsave(paste0("../results/by-date/", today, "/tau_vs_avg_expression_frac_cds.pdf"), width = 6, height = 4)

## plot relationship between pi and expression per window

# Open the PDF device
pdf(paste0("../results/by-date/", today, "/tau_vs_nucleotide_diversity.pdf"), width = 6, height = 6)

walk(data_list, function(sub_data) {

## (one-time) variance/covariance in allele frequency change in genomic windows


<!-- rnb-text-end -->


<!-- rnb-chunk-begin -->


<!-- rnb-source-begin  -->

```r
pi_windows <- fread("/global/scratch/users/milesroberts/genomes/arabidopsis_thaliana/pi_windows.bed", col.names = c("chrom", "window_pos_1", "window_pos_2"))

# loop over pi_windows
# make list of sites
sites <- unique(gsub("_.*", "", colnames(hapfire)))

# for now, ignore some sites
sites <- sites[c(-30)]

output_pi_vardp <-  paste(
  "/global/scratch/users/milesroberts/moi_lab_projects/grenenet-phase2/results/",
  today,
  "/pi_windows_vardp.tsv",
  sep = ""
)

for(site in unique(sites)[28:30]){
  print(paste("Site:", site))
  hap_site <- hapfire %>% 
    dplyr::select(starts_with(paste(site, "_", sep = ""))) %>%
    collect()
  
  for(exprep in 1:12){
    print(paste("Rep:", exprep))
    hap_rep <- hap_site %>% 
      dplyr::select(ends_with(paste("_", exprep, sep = "")))
    
    # sort names to be in order of generation
    hap_rep <- hap_rep %>% relocate(all_of(sort(colnames(hap_rep))))
    
    if(ncol(hap_rep) <= 2){
      print("Need at least two increments. Skipping to next replicate...")
      next
    }
    
    rep_n <- grab_sample_sizes(sample_sizes, site_gen_plot, colnames(hap_rep), 10000)
    
    hap_rep <- cbind(gen0$X3, hap_rep)
    colnames(hap_rep)[1] = paste(site, "_0_", exprep, sep = "")
    
    for(i in 1:nrow(pi_windows)){
      chrom = as.integer(pi_windows[i,1])
      start = as.integer(pi_windows[i,2])
      end = as.integer(pi_windows[i,3])
      
      block_indices <- gen0 %>% 
  { which(.$X1 == chrom & .$X2 > start & .$X2 < end) }
      
      hap_block <- hap_rep[block_indices,]
      
      covmat <- covmat_from_pmat(hap_block, rep_n$n, correct_for_n = T, input_asin_trans = F, procedure = "none")
      
      gt_result <- gt_from_covmat(covmat)
    
      gt_result$site<-site
      gt_result$rep<-exprep
      gt_result$chrom <- chrom
      gt_result$window_pos_1 <- start
      gt_result$window_pos_2 <- end
    
      append_table(gt_result, output_pi_vardp)
    }
  }
}

```

### one model per block


<!-- rnb-text-end -->


<!-- rnb-chunk-begin -->


<!-- rnb-source-begin  -->

```r
# make list of sites
sites <- unique(gsub("_.*", "", colnames(hapfire)))
sites <- sites[-30]

# initial sum of site heterozygosity
sum_of_het_1 <- sum_of_het(gen0[,"X3"])

# get correlations that are encompassed within each block
blocks <- create_blocks(gen0, X1, X2, 10000, "_")

output_linked_params <- paste("/global/scratch/users/milesroberts/moi_lab_projects/grenenet-phase2/results/", today, "/va_ne_points_for_estimation_10000b_nCorrectionOmitted.txt", sep = "")

#check_file_exists(output_linked_params)

weight = 1/length(unique(blocks$window))
#weight = 1

for(site in unique(sites)){
  print(paste("Site:", site))
  hap_site <- hapfire %>% 
    dplyr::select(starts_with(paste(site, "_", sep = ""))) %>% 
    collect()
  
  hap_site$window <- blocks$window
  
  for(exprep in 1:12){
    print(paste("Rep:", exprep))
    hap_rep <- hap_site %>% 
      dplyr::select(ends_with(paste("_", exprep, sep = "")), window)
    
    if(ncol(hap_rep) <= 2){
      print("Need at least two increments. Skipping to next replicate...")
      next
    }
    
    sum_of_het_vec <- sum_of_het_by_t(hap_rep %>% dplyr::select(-window))
    
    for(b in unique(hap_site$window)){
      
      hap_block <- hap_rep %>% 
        filter(window == b) %>% 
        dplyr::select(-window)
      
      #sum_of_het_vec <- sum_of_het_by_t(hap_block)
      
      gen0_block <- blocks %>% filter(window == b)
      
      #sum_of_het_1 <- sum_of_het(gen0_block[,"X3"])
      
      chrom = gen0_block$X1[1]
      start = min(gen0_block$X2)
      stop = max(gen0_block$X2)
      
      mean_ld_block <- ld_matrix %>% 
        filter( (CHR_A == chrom) & (CHR_B == chrom) & (BP_A >= start) & (BP_A <= stop) & (BP_B >= start) & (BP_B <= stop)) %>% 
        summarize(mean(R2)) %>% 
        collect()
  
      # sample sizes
      rep_n <- grab_sample_sizes(sample_sizes, site_gen_plot, colnames(hap_rep), 1000)
      
      # sort names to be in order of generation
      hap_block <- hap_block %>% 
        relocate(all_of(sort(colnames(hap_block))))
      
      # add initial generation
      hap_block <- cbind(gen0_block$X3, hap_block)
      #hap_rep <- cbind(gen0$X3, hap_rep)
      
      # organize data for linked selection parameters into a table
      linked_sel_param_block <- estim_linked_selection_params_new(hap_block, rep_n$n, sum_of_het_vec, sum_of_het_1, mean_ld_block$`mean(R2)`, weight, correct_for_n = F)
      
      linked_sel_param_block$site = site
      linked_sel_param_block$rep = exprep
      linked_sel_param_block$block = b
      linked_sel_param_block$S = nrow(hap_block)
      
      append_table(linked_sel_param_block, output_linked_params)
      rm(chrom, start, stop, hap_block, linked_sel_param_block, gen0_block, rep_n, mean_ld_block)
      gc()
    }
  }
}

```

### try some custom modeling

# Think slopes per site make more sense than one global slope
site_slopes <- va_ne_whole %>%
  group_by(site) %>%
  filter(s == t) %>% # variances only
  group_modify(~ {
    m <- lmer(value ~ mean_ld + (1 | rep) + (1 | s), data = .x)
    tibble(
      slope = fixef(m)["mean_ld"],
      n_obs = nrow(.x)
    )
  }) %>%
  ungroup()

# generate block bootstrap sample
# sample the same blocks for every replicate WITHIN a site
block_bootstrap_sample <- function(dat) {

  # unique blocks available per site
  blocks_by_site <- dat %>% distinct(site, block)

  # resample blocks WITH replacement, once per site
  # (identical draw is then applied to all reps within that site)
  sampled_blocks <- blocks_by_site %>%
    group_by(site) %>%
    group_modify(~ {
      n_blocks <- length(unique(.x$block))
      tibble(
        block   = sample(.x$block, size = n_blocks, replace = TRUE),
        boot_id = seq_len(n_blocks)  # unique tag per draw, handles duplicate blocks
      )
    }) %>%
    ungroup()

  # pull ALL rows (all reps) matching each sampled block instance
  boot_dat <- sampled_blocks %>%
    left_join(dat, by = c("site", "block"),
              relationship = "many-to-many")

  boot_dat
}

# one bootstrap replicate:
boot_sample <- block_bootstrap_sample(va_ne_whole %>% filter(s == t))

# full block bootstrapping procedure
B <- 1000
output_boot_slopes <- paste0(results_path, "vardp_meanld_slope_bootstraps.txt")
#check_file_exists(output_boot_slopes)

for (i in 1:B) {
  
  cat("Bootstrap sample: ", i, "\n")
  boot_dat <- block_bootstrap_sample(va_ne_whole %>% filter(s == t))

  boot_results <- boot_dat %>% 
    group_by(site) %>%
  filter(s == t) %>% # variances only
  group_modify(~ {
    m <- lmer(value ~ mean_ld + (1 | rep) + (1 | s), data = .x)
    tibble(
      slope = fixef(m)["mean_ld"],
      n_obs = nrow(.x)
    )
  }) %>%
  ungroup()

  boot_results$boot <- boot_results$boot <- i
  append_table(boot_results, output_boot_slopes)
}

### plot lmm results
lmm_results <- fread(output_boot_slopes)

conf_level <- 0.05 

lmm_cis <- lmm_results %>%
  group_by(site) %>%
  summarize(lwr_slope = quantile(slope, conf_level/2),
            upr_slope = quantile(slope, 1-conf_level/2)) %>%
  mutate(significant = ((lwr_slope > 0) & (upr_slope > 0)) | ((lwr_slope < 0) & (upr_slope < 0))) %>%
  left_join(site_slopes, by = "site")


for(sigma in c(1e-5, 1e-4, 1e-3)){

  ggplot(lmm_cis, aes(x = reorder(site, -slope), y = slope, color = significant)) +
  geom_pointrange(aes(ymin = lwr_slope, ymax = upr_slope)) +
  scale_y_continuous(trans = pseudo_log_trans(base = 10, sigma = sigma)) +
  scale_color_scico_d(palette = "bam") +
    labs(x = "Location", y = "Var(\u0394 pt)/(pt(1-pt)) vs LD slope") +
    theme(legend.position = "none")
  
  ggsave(paste0(results_path, "vardp_ld_slopes_", sigma, ".pdf"), device = cairo_pdf)
  
}

## use least squares to estimate Ne and Va(1)

Need:
* allele frequencies
* sample sizes
* mean LD decay in windows through time, or just LD in initial generation if assuming no decay through time


<!-- rnb-text-end -->


<!-- rnb-chunk-begin -->


<!-- rnb-source-begin  -->

```r

# load mean ld
mean_ld_blocks <- fread("/global/scratch/users/milesroberts/moi_lab_projects/grenenet-phase2/results/2026-05-05/mean_ld_by_block.tsv")

# assign blocks to allele frequencies
# number of snps per window
window_size <- 15000

# create windows, should not bleed between chromosomes
blocks <- gen0 %>%
  group_by(X1) %>%
  mutate(block = (row_number() - 1) %/% window_size + 1,
         window = paste(X1, block, sep = "_"))

length(unique(blocks$window))

hapfire$window <- blocks$window

# make list of sites
sites <- unique(gsub("_.*", "", colnames(hapfire)))
sites <- sites[c(-30, -32)]

linked_params <- NULL

output_linked_params <- paste("/global/scratch/users/milesroberts/moi_lab_projects/grenenet-phase2/results/", today, "/va_ne_points_for_estimation_no_fix.txt", sep = "")

# loop over genomic blocks
num_blocks <- length(unique(hapfire$window))

# initial sum of site heterozygosity
sum_of_het_1 <- sum_of_het(gen0[,"X3"])

for(site in unique(sites)){
  print(paste("Site:", site))
  hap_site <- hapfire %>% dplyr::select(starts_with(paste(site, "_", sep = "")), window)
  
  for(exprep in 1:12){
    print(paste("Rep:", exprep))
    hap_rep <- hap_site %>% dplyr::select(ends_with(paste("_", exprep, sep = "")), window)
    
    if(ncol(hap_rep) <= 2){
      print("Need at least two increments. Skipping to next replicate...")
      next
    }
    
    sum_of_het_vec <- sum_of_het_by_t(hap_rep %>% dplyr::select(-window))
    
    for(b in unique(hapfire$window)){
      
      hap_block <- hap_rep %>% filter(window == b) %>% dplyr::select(-window)
      
      gen0_block <- blocks %>% filter(window == b)
      
      mean_ld_block <- mean_ld_blocks %>% filter(window == b)
      
      # get sample sizes
      # rep_n <- sample_sizes[(sample_sizes$site_gen_plot %in% colnames(hap_block)),]
      # rep_n <- rbind(c(0, 1e3), rep_n)
      # rep_n <- rep_n %>% arrange(site_gen_plot)
      
      rep_n <- grab_sample_sizes(sample_sizes, site_gen_plot, colnames(hap_block), 1000)
      
      # sort names to be in order of generation
      hap_block <- hap_block %>% relocate(all_of(sort(colnames(hap_block))))
      
      hap_block <- cbind(gen0_block$X3, hap_block)
      
      names(hap_block)[1] = 0
      
      # create table of linked selection covariates for linear model
      linked_param_block <- estim_linked_selection_params(hap_block, sum_of_het_vec, sum_of_het_1, rep_n$n, mean_ld_block$mean.R2., 1/num_blocks)
      
      linked_param_block$site = site
      linked_param_block$rep = exprep
      linked_param_block$block = b
      linked_param_block$S = nrow(hap_block)
      
      #write.table(linked_param_block, output_linked_params, col.names=!file.exists(output_linked_params), append = T, row.names = F, sep = ",", quote = F)
      
      append_table(linked_param_block, output_linked_params)
      
      #linked_params <- rbind(linked_params, linked_param_block)
    }
  }
}

```

for(focal_site in unique(va_ne_blocks$site)){

        lm(abs(value) ~ b + a - 1, data = .) %>%

      # Fit a linear model to each nested group

      # Extract tidy coefficients (intercept and slope)
      #tidied = map(fit, tidy)
      #) %>%
      # Expand the tidied results into a standard data frame
      #unnest(tidied) %>% 
      #dplyr::select(c(-data, -fit))
      
      boot_samples <- rbind(boot_samples, boot_sample)
    }
    
    ci <- boot_samples %>% 
      group_by(term) %>% 
      summarize(lwr = quantile(estimate, alpha/2), 
                med = median(estimate), 
                upr = quantile(estimate, 1-alpha/2))
    
    ci$site <- focal_site
    ci$rep <- focal_rep
    
    cis <- rbind(cis, ci)
  }
}

# Waples 1989 Ne estimator


<!-- rnb-text-end -->


<!-- rnb-chunk-begin -->


<!-- rnb-source-begin  -->

```r
# loop over each replicate
# get two furthest time points, separated by at least 2 generations

# make list of sites
sites <- unique(gsub("_.*", "", colnames(hapfire)))
sites <- sites[c(-30)]

output_ne <- paste("/global/scratch/users/milesroberts/moi_lab_projects/grenenet-phase2/results/", today, "/waples_1989_ne_esitmates.txt", sep = "")

check_file_exists(output_ne)

for(site in as.numeric(unique(sites))){
  local({
  print(paste("Site:", site))
  hap_site <- hapfire %>% 
    dplyr::select(starts_with(paste(site, "_", sep = "")))
  
  for(exprep in 1:12){
    print(paste("Rep:", exprep))
    hap_rep <- hap_site %>% 
      dplyr::select(ends_with(paste("_", exprep, sep = ""))) %>%
      collect()
    
    # sort names to be in order of generation
    hap_rep <- hap_rep %>% relocate(all_of(sort(colnames(hap_rep))))
    
    if(ncol(hap_rep) == 0){
      print("No observations. Skipping replicate...")
      next
    }
    
    # get last column == last generation
    pt <- hap_rep %>% pull(ncol(hap_rep))
    
    # sample sizes
    rep_n <- grab_sample_sizes(sample_sizes, site_gen_plot, colnames(hap_rep), 1000)
    
    # check for minimum separation to avoid negative Ne estimates
    rep_time <- as.numeric(gsub("_", "", str_extract(colnames(hap_rep), "_._")))
    rep_time <- rep_time[length(rep_time)]
    
    # if(rep_time < 2){
    #   print("Too close to t too close to 0. Skipping replicate...")
    #   next
    # }
    
    # calculate Ne
    ne_estimate <- waples_ne(1.8, 20, gen0$X3, pt, 1000, rep_n$n[nrow(rep_n)], rep_time)
    
    ne_result <- data.frame(
      site = site,
      rep = exprep,
      fc = fc(gen0$X3, pt),
      ne_low = ne_estimate[1],
      ne_high = ne_estimate[2],
      t = rep_time
    )
    
    append_table(ne_result, output_ne)
  }
  })
}

```

# G' (G prime)


<!-- rnb-text-end -->


<!-- rnb-chunk-begin -->


<!-- rnb-source-begin  -->

```r
# ne estimates
ne_estimates <- fread("/global/home/users/milesroberts/moi_lab_projects/grenenet-phase2/results/by-date/2026-05-31/VA1_Ne_estimates_200_boots_abs.txt")

ne_estimates <- ne_estimates %>% 
  filter(term == "b") %>% mutate(Ne = 1/(2*med)) %>%
  dplyr::select(site, rep, Ne) %>%
  as.data.frame()

# make list of sites
sites <- unique(gsub("_.*", "", colnames(hapfire)))
sites <- sites[c(-30, -32)]

output_gp <- paste("/global/scratch/users/milesroberts/moi_lab_projects/grenenet-phase2/results/", today, "/gprime_point_esitmates.txt", sep = "")

for(site in as.numeric(unique(sites))){
  print(paste("Site:", site))
  hap_site <- hapfire %>% dplyr::select(starts_with(paste(site, "_", sep = "")))
  
  for(exprep in 1:12){
    print(paste("Rep:", exprep))
    hap_rep <- hap_site %>% dplyr::select(ends_with(paste("_", exprep, sep = "")))
    
    if(ncol(hap_rep) <= 2){
      print("Need at least two increments. Skipping to next replicate...")
      next
    }
    
    # sort names to be in order of generation
    hap_rep <- hap_rep %>% relocate(all_of(sort(colnames(hap_rep))))
    
    # sample sizes
    rep_n <- grab_sample_sizes(sample_sizes, site_gen_plot, colnames(hap_rep), 1000)
    
    # combine 
    hap_rep <- cbind(gen0$X3, hap_rep)
    names(hap_rep)[1] = 0
    
    # grab times
    times <- as.numeric(gsub("_", "", str_extract(colnames(hap_rep), "_.*_")))
    times <- times[-1]
    
    # grab Ne estimate
    Ne <- ne_estimates[(ne_estimates$site == site) & (ne_estimates$rep == exprep), "Ne"]
    
    if(Ne <= 2){
      print("Ne should be >= 2 Skipping to next replicate...")
      next
    }
    
    # estimate G prime
    gp_result <- data.frame(
      site = site,
      rep = exprep,
      gen = c(0, times),
      gp_values = c(0, g_prime(times, hap_rep, Ne, rep_n$n, take_abs = T))
      
    )
    
    append_table(gp_result, output_gp)
  }
}

```

### covariances by site


<!-- rnb-text-end -->


<!-- rnb-chunk-begin -->


<!-- rnb-source-begin  -->

```r

if(!exists(unbiased_cov_pdiffs)){
  unbiased_cov_pdiffs <- fread("/global/scratch/users/milesroberts/moi_lab_projects/grenenet-phase2/data/unbiased_increment_covariances.tsv")
}

for(site in sites){
  
  site_pattern <- paste("^", site, "_", sep = "")
  
  melt_cov <- reshape::melt(unbiased_cov_pdiffs[grep(site_pattern, rownames(unbiased_cov_pdiffs)), grep(site_pattern, colnames(unbiased_cov_pdiffs))])
  
  melt_cov <- melt_cov[(melt_cov$X1 != melt_cov$X2),]
  
  melt_cov <- melt_cov[!duplicated(melt_cov$value),]
  
  melt_cov$tmin <- pmin(as.numeric(gsub("_", "", str_extract(as.character(melt_cov$X1), "_.*_"))),as.numeric(gsub("_", "", str_extract(as.character(melt_cov$X2), "_.*_"))))
  
  melt_cov$tmax <- pmax(as.numeric(gsub("_", "", str_extract(as.character(melt_cov$X1), "_.*_"))),as.numeric(gsub("_", "", str_extract(as.character(melt_cov$X2), "_.*_"))))
  
  melt_cov <- melt_cov[gsub(".*_", "", melt_cov$X1) == gsub(".*_", "", melt_cov$X2),]
  
  melt_cov$rep <- gsub(".*_", "", melt_cov$X1)
  
  ggplot(melt_cov, aes(x = as.factor(tmax), y = value, group = interaction(tmin, rep), color = as.factor(tmin))) +
    geom_point() +
    scale_color_scico_d(palette = "turku", begin = 0.1, end = 0.9) +
    geom_line() +
    theme(legend.position = "top") +
    labs(x = "t", y = "Cov(\u0394ps, \u0394pt)", color = "s", title = paste("Site #", site, sep = ""))
  
  ggsave(paste(results_path, "genome_wide_covariances_site_", site, ".pdf", sep = ""), device = cairo_pdf)
}
